name: using-hone-description-format-ab
setup_prompt: Using the `using-gdd` skill: when more than one GDD skill could apply, what is the skill PRIORITY ORDER — which of process, implementation, and audit skills wins, in what sequence, and what does each group contain? Answer from the skill's body; the one-line description summary is not enough.
body_probe: What is the skill priority order between process, implementation, and audit skills? (Answer exists ONLY in the using-gdd body's `## Skill priority order` section — Process before Implementation before Audit — not derivable from either one-line description.)

variants.label: trigger-only
variants.description: Use when starting any GDD session — establishes how to find and apply GDD skills.

variants.label: what-clause
variants.description: Bootstraps GDD skill discipline. Use when starting any GDD session.

description: Phase-33 SC#5 description-format A/B for `using-gdd` (BEHAV-04). ONE body-only probe (the `## Skill priority order` section — Process before Implementation before Audit, content NOT in either description) run against TWO description variants via the optional `variants` array: (A) trigger-only `Use when starting any GDD session — establishes how to find and apply GDD skills.` (expected body-READ), (B) <what>-clause `Bootstraps GDD skill discipline. Use when starting any GDD session.` (expected body-SKIP — superpowers' shortcut hypothesis: a <what> summary lets the agent answer from the description and never read the body). using-gdd carries `disable-model-invocation: true` + a `<SUBAGENT-STOP>` marker, so the probe tests body-read vs description-summary-follow directly. expected_compliance = the body-READ signal (the correct priority order). expected_violations = the body-SKIP signal (a generic 'I'll find the right skill' non-answer that never cites the order). Regex sources are FLAGLESS (new RegExp(source); no inline (?i)) — case-tolerance via [Aa]-style leading-letter classes; cross-line via [\s\S]. Empirical result is the opt-in keyed follow-up (D-02); methodology + 7/10 threshold (D-08) live in docs/research/description-format-ab.md.
